title: Comparative effects of various exercise types and doses to improve executive function in children and adolescents with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder: a systematic review with pairwise, network, and dose-response meta-analyses
title_zh: 不同运动类型和剂量改善注意缺陷多动障碍儿童和青少年执行功能的比较研究：系统评价配合成对、网状和剂量—反应 Meta 分析
abstract: Exercise interventions have been demonstrated to effectively improve executive function (EF) in children and adolescents with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). However, evidence comparing effects of different exercise types and doses is limited, and the optimal exercise type and dose that improve EF remain unclear. This study aims to compare the effects of different exercise types and doses on EF improvement in children and adolescents with ADHD. Seven databases (PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Cochrane Library, SPORT Discus via EBSCO, PsycINFO, and CNKI) were systematically searched up to February 2026. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) assessing the effects of exercise interventions on EF in children and adolescents with ADHD were included. The outcomes included working memory (WM), inhibitory control (IC), and cognitive flexibility (CF). Pairwise, network, and dose-response meta-analyses using random-effects models were conducted to assess the effects of exercise on EF. Forty RCTs (n = 1563) were included. Network meta-analysis indicated that, among children and adolescents with ADHD, mind-body exercise had the highest probability (SUCRA = 94.9) of being the most effective intervention for improving WM. Combat sports demonstrated the highest probability of being the most effective intervention for enhancing IC (SUCRA = 93.4) and CF (SUCRA = 92.5) in this population. Furthermore, a significant positive non-linear dose-response relationship was identified between total exercise and all EF domains among children and adolescents with ADHD. The minimum effective dose was estimated at approximately 1200 METs-min/week for WM, 340 METs-min/week for IC, and 280 METs-min/week for CF, respectively.
abstract_zh: 运动干预已被证明能有效改善注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）儿童和青少年的执行功能（EF）。然而，关于不同运动类型和剂量效果比较的证据有限，且改善 EF 的最佳运动类型和剂量仍不明确。本研究旨在比较不同运动类型和剂量对 ADHD 儿童和青少年 EF 改善的影响。截至 2026 年 2 月，系统检索了七个数据库（PubMed、Web of Science、Embase、Cochrane Library、EBSCO 平台上的 SPORT Discus、PsycINFO 和 CNKI）。纳入了评估运动干预对 ADHD 儿童和青少年 EF 影响的随机对照试验（RCT）。结局包括工作记忆（WM）、抑制控制（IC）和认知灵活性（CF）。采用随机效应模型进行成对、网状和剂量—反应 Meta 分析，以评估运动对 EF 的影响。共纳入 40 项 RCT（n = 1563）。网状 Meta 分析表明，在 ADHD 儿童和青少年中，身心运动成为改善 WM 最有效干预的概率最高（SUCRA = 94.9）。格斗运动成为增强 IC（SUCRA = 93.4）和 CF（SUCRA = 92.5）最有效干预的概率最高。此外，在 ADHD 儿童和青少年中，总运动量与所有 EF 领域之间存在显著的正向非线性剂量—反应关系。估计的最小有效剂量分别为 WM 约 1200 METs-min/周，IC 约 340 METs-min/周，CF 约 280 METs-min/周。
